episodes.synopsis: There's a candy thief at large and Butt Detective's on the case with Brown as his backup. But the trail of the culprit leads right into a lake.
episodes.title: Episode 1

episodes.synopsis: Butt Detective goes to the station, where the officers are looking into who's behind a string of burglaries. But the chief has another job for them.
episodes.title: Episode 2

episodes.synopsis: After a Kaito the canine crook threatens to steal the Goddess Scarf from the museum, Butt Detective prepares to protect the precious booty.
episodes.title: Episode 3

episodes.synopsis: The Black Shadow thieves are in town and the police ask Butt Detective for assistance in putting an end to their mischief before any theft occurs.
episodes.title: Episode 4

episodes.synopsis: Butt Detective, Brown and Chief Maltese must get to the bottom of the Black Shadow Gang's burglaries. Later, they search for the leader's hideout.
episodes.title: Episode 5

episodes.synopsis: After someone leaves a strange box at the Lucky Cat, the police show up to help only to find they're behind Butt Detective, who's already on the case.
episodes.title: Episode 6

episodes.synopsis: A conversation at a feline cafe leads Butt Detective to reveal the backstory of how Brown became his assistant, going back to how he learned to talk.
episodes.title: Episode 7

episodes.synopsis: A potato-loving lady clad in purple knocks on Butt Detective's door and asks him to get to the bottom of a mysterious message from her ancestors.
episodes.title: Episode 8

episodes.synopsis: The purple potato case continues as Butt Detective, Brown and their purple companion head into the ancestors' hut. But it appears to be empty.
episodes.title: Episode 9

episodes.synopsis: While hearing about a forest cafe's missing manager, Butt Detective realizes he's been tailed by a persistent koala who may be after Brown's job.
episodes.title: Episode 10
